When I returned to my vehicle, I noticed small dents across the hood, on the roof, and along the upper panels on the left side (front fender and upper portions of the left doors). The dents are consistent with hail. No other vehicle was involved. There was no contact of any kind. I did not contact police since there was no accident or other driver.
